caseName: King County v. F. L. Hartung Glass Co.
caseNameFull: KING COUNTY v. F. L. HARTUNG GLASS CO., INC.
attorneys: William L. Paul, Jr. for appellants., Ofell H. Johnson for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
